This place offers a relatively low diagnosis fee, but I'd be cautious about taking your car here for diagnoses (there's a reason why it's cheaper than other places). I had an intermittent no-start issue. Took my car here for a diagnosis, and they spent only a few minutes to run a battery test and came back telling me that it's a battery issue and it needs charging. I knew the battery is fine because I had it tested the day before. So I asked them to look further, and instead of doing a thorough diagnosis, Sam pressed the start button a few times and immediately made the conclusion that it's a starter issue and it needs to be replaced. I was surprised by how hasty he was so I asked how he knew, and he said that "well I'm a mechanic". Later he gave me an estimate of $1000 to replace the starter. Luckily I decided to take my car to the dealership instead, and turned out the issue was neither the battery nor the starter.

These guys are awesome! The team is very nice, super reasonable, and very responsive. The owner, Ali, is so sweet, helpful, and knowledgeable. He explained exactly what needed to be done after my car got hit. Couldn’t have picked a better auto shop to handle my first accident!
